verdict: McDonald's grew revenue 3% to $7.1B and operating income 5% to $3.4B — comparable sales rose 3.6% across every segment — but franchised rent and royalties did the lifting while company-run restaurant sales fell 3%.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: vs a year ago (+1% in constant currencies)

segments.name: Franchised restaurants
segments.note: Rent and royalties paid by the local owners who run most McDonald's restaurants — the heart of the business model.

segments.name: Company-owned restaurants
segments.note: Food and drink sold at restaurants McDonald's runs itself.

segments.name: Other revenues
segments.note: Fees from franchisees for technology and digital platforms, plus brand-licensing income.

opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: Head office, marketing support and running the global franchising machine — $785M of SG&A (including $121M of depreciation and amortization), less $37M of other operating income.

takeaways.title: Comps rose everywhere
takeaways.text: Global comparable sales rose 3.6% — the U.S. +2.4% on positive check growth, International Operated Markets +4.3% led by Germany and Australia, and licensed markets +4.7% led by Japan. Systemwide sales rose 8% to over $36B.

takeaways.title: EPS rose 2%
takeaways.text: Diluted EPS was $3.18, up 2%. Excluding $39M of pre-tax restructuring charges under 'Accelerating the Organization', it was $3.22. Operating income rose 5% to $3.4B.

takeaways.title: Franchisees carry the model
takeaways.text: Franchise revenue — rent and royalties from other people's restaurants — was $4.4B, 62% of all revenue, and grew 7%. Company-run stores shrank 3% to $2.6B at much thinner margins.

oneTimers: Net pre-tax charges of $39M ($0.04 per share), primarily restructuring charges under the 'Accelerating the Organization' program to modernize how the company works; excluding them, operating income rose 3%.
otherDetail: Interest expense of $406M on McDonald's debt, plus $1M of net nonoperating expense.
footerNote: The release's printed lines are rounded: the revenue lines sum to $7,077M vs the $7,078M total printed (the $1M difference is carried in Other revenues), and the interest and nonoperating lines sum to pre-tax income of $2,950M vs the $2,949M printed; this page follows the printed totals and net income.
segmentNote: Systemwide sales grew 8% (6% in constant currency) to over $36B; comparable sales: U.S. +2.4%, International Operated Markets +4.3%, International Developmental Licensed Markets +4.7%.
